text:
Hear me. I have seen.

There is blood in the ears of grain

and blood in the clods,

and the wounds

are full of earth and full

of seeds that germinate.


I have seen

boot prints that have passed through,

breaking the cornfields,

and forbidden voices haranguing

rebellious manioc fields.


I have seen

the little sword of the palm rise angrily,

seeking someone to wield it,

and hands stretched out in search of it,

bleeding on the thorns.


I have seen

the swollen furrow break open,

full of potential forces,

with tremors arriving unbridled

from the quebracho groves.


I have seen

the fury of the wind redoubling

its rages with its sorrows.

And hear me.

The earth is forging

its wings, without chains.

translation.title: Wings and Chains
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Soler's agricultural uprising imagery, with earth, crops, and quebracho groves becoming insurgent.
